Bind the reviewed native and poststart validation to the integrated source

Rebind source identity, nine provider pins, the formatted native emitter and the derived Python-origin population. Preserve every reviewed Python helper, all 24 native unit names, the original 29 controls, three native-output consumers, separate producer plus six Python cases, installed 1/10/100 diagnostic and every deadline and retention bound. This immutable review object activates no branch or run.
